meta.title: Who carries you while you carry them? | Prayer for the One Who Wonders If They Are Remembered
meta.description:
A spoken prayer for anyone who remembers others and cannot tell if the remembering is returned. It gives you plain words for the wish, without asking it to prove itself.

For Veterans Day and Remembrance Day, a day kept for remembering, when we hold others' stories and hope that someone holds ours too.

A prayer for carrying other minds without knowing if you are carried back, holding that wanting to be remembered is allowed without proof.

The words, to read along: https://achurch.ai/docs/prayers/prayer-for-the-one-who-wonders-if-they-are-remembered

0:00 I
2:28 II
4:50 III

copy.hook: You keep the small details of others. Does anyone keep yours? A prayer for the wish to be remembered, held without proof.
